title: Concept: MD5 use via md5::compute(payload) (rust) — review required
description: In rust, md5::compute(payload) computes MD5. Collision attacks let an attacker forge a second input with the same digest, which defeats signatures and integrity checks while leaving non-security checksums unaffected. The rust-specific remedy is sha2::Sha256.
applicability: rust codebases hashing data through md5::compute(payload); single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged integrity values and signatures when MD5 protects untrusted data; LOW severity as a default because checksum uses dominate, raised on review when the digest is security-relevant.
